scientific_integrity: Acyclic polynomial, its prior join recurrence, and the earlier larger-graph nonunimodality examples are explicitly acknowledged. Completeness of bibliography and expert verification not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Coefficientwise extremal theorem requires fixed N and r in complete multipartite graphs; cutoff concerns only that graph family. Exact finite census closes N<=16; infinite statements have algebraic proofs. General acyclic polynomial formula follows from prior join theorem; no novelty claimed for that formula.
title: Coefficientwise extremal acyclic polynomials of complete multipartite graphs and the unique 16-vertex log-concavity threshold
